script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now. Pluto in Aquarius is squaring your 10th House career ambitions while Saturn in Pisces squares your fixed air ruler Uranus, stalling your public path. This friction hits your 2nd House of money and your 6th House health routines, and Mercury in Libra may stir your 4th House home. This square asks for patience with your 12th House hidden fears. In love, Uranus in Taurus opposes your 7th House partnerships, so expect a loyal but unpredictable bond; avoid power struggles tonight. Your 8th House intimacy may feel electrified. Career and money demand you release one old identity role before chasing a promotion, or your 10th House goals stall. A warning: do not bulldoze a stubborn coworker, but an unexpected gift arrives through an old ally’s invitation. Follow for tomorrow’s reading, and stay open, Aquarius.
